name: Behringer WAVE
description: Behringer WAVE 8-voice hybrid wavetable synthesizer: every sound parameter of its manual's MIDI chapter, both groups (A and B), sent as the controller or NRPN it prints, and read back from the edit buffer.

sources.title: WAVE User Manual
sources.notes: MIDI chapter (pages 34 - 38): the controller, NRPN and preset byte tables, read by tools/profiles/behringer/read-behringer-tables.mjs from Manual_BE_0722-ABD_WAVE.pdf (sha256 83d17572d8edd49ed452eea41fef4b58c9611de9ff6f87e21140a196776792b4), https://cdn-media.empowertribe.com/2ee6f3a6dfad48bb85241add20b97f07/Manual_BE_0722-ABD_WAVE.pdf; the edit buffer request from its SysEx section. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/behringer/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/behringer/synths/, not this file.
Each sound parameter is a byte of the preset, written as the controller or NRPN the manual prints for it and read back from the edit buffer. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The WAVE takes sound parameters only when PAR-COM (its MIDI settings) is 2 or 3, and sends them when it is 1 or 3.

Group A's and group B's parameters are sent on the same controllers: the WAVE applies one to the group Group Select (CC 31) chooses, so set it before editing the other group. Pull reads both groups as they are.

Rows the manual prints wrongly, corrected by the layout: byte 22 (A EO, printed 0-1: 0-9, as B's and the NRPN's); byte 31 (A SEMIT V8, printed SEMIT V7 as byte 30 is, its notes Voice 8); byte 82 (B SEMIT V8, printed SEMIT V7 as byte 81 is, its notes Voice 8); byte 106 (B SW, printed 0-3: 0-6, as A's and the NRPN's).
Read back and not written, no controller or NRPN being printed for them: Name, A Analog Mod Wheel Position, B Analog Mod Wheel Position.

Left out: NRPN 0:46 BPM (Arp/Seq - Speed (MSB/LSB), 40-240: more than a data byte, and the manual does not say how it is split); CC 0 Bank Select MSB; CC 1 Modulation Wheel; CC 6 NRPN Data MSB; CC 7 Volume; CC 11 Expression Pedal; CC 32 Bank Select LSB; CC 64 Sustain Pedal; CC 98 NRPN Para# LSB; CC 99 NRPN Para# MSB; CC 120 All Sound Off; CC 121 Reset all Controllers; CC 122 Local Control; CC 123 All Notes Off.

coverage.realtimeEditing: the controllers and NRPNs, each to the group Group Select chooses
coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these controllers and NRPNs when PAR-COM is 1 or 3
